money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 5 Jan 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 5 Jan 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.55%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 5 Jan 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 7 Jan 2026 (table headed 06.01.2026; only the 5 Jan 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. No table is headed 5 Jan: the 6 Jan table (Polish holiday) shows zero change on every PLN line and differs from the 2 Jan table, so it carries the 5 Jan close. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 5 Jan 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 5 Jan 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 5 Jan 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.25% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (OK0426 3.27%, DS0726 3.21%, PS1026 3.26%).
